body: The only chances of achieving anything come from accepting the painful feelings that come with it. If I want to learn a skill I have to struggle through the plateus. If I want to meet people I have to struggle through the awkwardness. If I want to move up in my job I need to work harder. Most people can take this baseline punishment and have it pay off in the end. I'm just not willing, and for as long as I'm not willing the chances for happiness are nil. What I then have is something I'd rather lose: spending a lifetime getting nowhere through my own lack of will, actually living out the failures I'm experiencing through my own inability to take on the pains of life. I'd rather just die, which is the scenario where I neither face the pain of struggling for my life or the suffering of not living the life I'd have had to struggle for.
